description: (0.5.0, Draft) Publishing a keyless-signed body (RFC-ACDP-0021 §6.3). Behavioral, registry-side.

input.golden: kl-001 (controller did:web:agents.example.com:ci, identity oidc https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com / repo:example/pipeline:ref:refs/heads/main, registry did:web:registry.example.com)

expected.behavior: Accepted. The receipt and log leaf carry key_fingerprint = the attestation's key_fingerprint.

scenarios.name: B — the registry's created_at would be at or after not_after
C — acdp-kl- key_id with no key_attestation member
D — key_attestation names a ctx_id on another registry
E — key_attestation.content_hash differs from the stored attestation
F — agent_id differs from the attestation controller, or key_id/algorithm differ
H — signature does not verify under the attested key
I — key_attestation present but key_id fragment does not begin acdp-kl-

expected.behavior: Ordinary RFC-ACDP-0001 §5.11 resolution finds no verificationMethod with the acdp-kl- fragment. The body is never accepted.
